text: The frequency of nutrient consumption can influence muscle protein accretion. Given evidence of a leucine threshold, a case can be made for consuming multiple protein-rich meals throughout the day. Studies show dose-dependent and saturable effects at 10 g of EAAs, which is equivalent to approximately 20 g of a high-quality protein source (12). This is consistent with the 'muscle full' concept, which proposes that muscle protein synthesis becomes unresponsive to further increases in intake once the saturable level is reached (1 1). Circulating amino acids are then shunted to fuel other protein-requiring processes, to suppress proteolysis, or toward oxidation (33).
